### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/variant-docs.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/variant-docs.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 573a376554783b2d363bf39363d6c97e99c76ad4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `fbf3dc335045905d776c8c6b9cb9221880f49a98` — the merge of head `05955a54b0bcb097bd9f263112027579a55fa900` into base `573a376554783b2d363bf39363d6c97e99c76ad4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin fbf3dc335045905d776c8c6b9cb9221880f49a98 && git checkout fbf3dc335045905d776c8c6b9cb9221880f49a98
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 573a376554783b2d363bf39363d6c97e99c76ad4 05955a54b0bcb097bd9f263112027579a55fa900 && git checkout -B drift-repro 573a376554783b2d363bf39363d6c97e99c76ad4 && git merge --no-ff 05955a54b0bcb097bd9f263112027579a55fa900

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 573a376554783b2d363bf39363d6c97e99c76ad4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fcd041c76631de16bee3587554e29e56a4a3227f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanLaneStatistic.ts, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanColumnSummary.ts, ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx, packages/spec/variant-docs.json, .changeset/36520-kanban-lane-statistic-server.md

Inputs read: card #36520 (body and all 6 comments, claim 7121273158, os-dev-report 7123202553, claim amendment 7123235531), PR #36857 (body, 17 files, net diff against merge-base `06ef3c098e`), the 70 check-runs on this head (61 success, 9 skipped, none red). Nothing built or run. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`KanbanLaneSummarySchema` gains `avg`, `min`, `max` arms** (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:2387`): right. Three strict arms, `field` required and non-empty, same shape as the `sum` arm. A widening of a published accept-set; nothing a stored view writes today is refused. `kanban-config-lane-summary.test.ts` pins the six accepted variants and refuses `median`, an aggregate without `field`, an empty `field` and a stray key.
- **The `sum` arm keeps its key and field and changes what it means**: the `field` describe and the union describe move from "over its loaded cards" to "over all of its records". Right as the card's acceptance; it is a meaning change of an accepted value, judged under ③ (1).
- **Lint `kanbanSummaryRefusal`** (`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`): right. It now judges `avg` / `min` / `max` by their own aggregate × field-type row. No stored view is newly refused: those three types did not parse before this head, and for `sum` the verdict is unchanged (`BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` is exactly `boolean`, `toggle`, the two literals it replaces; `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:69`). Card item 7082726819 (read the boolean class from the spec in both places, fix the stale test comment) is done in the lint rule and in `ListView.laneStatisticSums`.
- **plugin-kanban public surface**: unchanged. `KanbanColumnSummary`, `KanbanLaneStatisticType` and the removed `laneStatistic` helper are not exported from the package entry (`exports` has `.` only; the index names none of them), so the widened `renderTotal` parameter and the removed helper are package-private.
- **Generated artifacts** (`variant-docs.json` key, strictness-ledger counts 227 to 230, reference `.mdx`): follow from the three new strict sites; `check:generated` and `check:variant-docs` are green in CI.
- **Wire surface**: none added. The read rides the existing `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders` to `POST /data/:object/query`; no server file is in the diff.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` minor: right, a new accepted value on an authorable key takes at least minor.
- `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` minor: right, each is a package the diff moves under a protocol kind other than `none`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` minor: accepted. The diff there is a three-line internal change; minor is the floor the kind sets on a moved package, so it is not wrong.
- `Clause-②: yes`: right. The published `KanbanConfig.summary` accept-set widens and its documented meaning changes. No `(narrowing)` arm is owed: nothing accepted before is refused now.
- No BREAKING carrier is owed. The level does not move under S1 below: `semantic` also takes minor.
- The changeset body states the `sum` change in its last paragraph, which is the right content; only the kind line beside it is wrong (S1).

### ③ Boundary flags

**(1) `Metadata-protocol`: `semantic`, not `added`.** AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3: "a changed meaning or default is `semantic`", and "several ⇒ `narrowed` over `semantic` over `added`". On `main` the published text of this value says the opposite of what this head ships: the docblock says `sum` totals "over the cards the lane has LOADED, not over every record of the lane", and both `.describe()` strings say "over its loaded cards" / "not every record of the lane". This head rewrites all three to "over all of its records". A stored `{ type: 'sum', field }` now draws a different number on a long lane, draws nothing over a data source without the aggregate door, and (PR body, acceptance notes) draws nothing over a record-mode currency field where it drew a figure before. The dev's option A rests on "the spec text always meant a lane statistic"; the text on `main` did not. Both kinds are present (`added` for the three arms, `semantic` for `sum`), so the rule's precedence gives `semantic`. Dev open question answered: B.

- **S1 (should-fix)** — the `Metadata-protocol:` line reads `added` in the PR body and in `.changeset/36520-kanban-lane-statistic-server.md`; both should read `semantic`. Level and `Clause-②:` stay as they are. The claim's line was written before the diff existed; the PR and changeset lines are the ones of record.

**(2) ViewSettingsPopover: in this PR.** Read at this head: `summaryWord` maps only `count` and `sum` and returns the raw type otherwise (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx:698-703`), and the lane-summary page offers none / count / sum only (`:1004-1014`), so a view with `avg` shows "avg · Amount" with no option selected. Nothing is overwritten unless the user picks another option. The view-settings picker is the product's writer of `kanban.summary`, so the new arms have no authoring surface and a raw untranslated word without it. The seat's claim amendment 7123235531 already widens the file surface to that component and to the locale packs for exactly this; this head does not contain it.

- **S2 (should-fix)** — the amended claim's two additions are missing at this head: the lane-statistic picker offering and naming `avg` / `min` / `max` (ViewSettingsPopover and the lane-summary page, with their locale labels), and removal of the orphaned `kanban.laneStatistic.loadedOnly` key (still present in ten locale packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/`). The offered fields per function should come from the same aggregate × field-type row the lint rule reads, less the boolean class.

**Security claims, verified as stated, by reading:**
- The grouped read carries the board's filter and search. Client: `compileLaneStatisticQuery` lowers the same `queryFilter` the lane queries send as `$filter` into `where` and returns `null` (no read, no figure) when it does not lower, and copies the host's `$search` / `$searchFields` (`KanbanLaneStatistic.ts:99-135`, `ObjectKanban.tsx` `laneStatisticQuestion`). Server: `findData` routes a body with `groupBy` / `aggregations` to `engine.aggregate` with `where`, `search`, `searchFields` and `context` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-data-crud.ts:646-666`); the engine searches rows before grouping (`packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:1071`).
- Same read scope and RLS as `find`. The engine dispatches the aggregate as an operation with its `where` on the AST so middleware filters land in it (`engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:1425-1432`). The authz middleware stamps `__readScope` for `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate` alike (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:1425-1428`, external-audience grant `:1455`), and step 3 injects the RLS predicate into `opCtx.ast.where` for any operation carrying an AST (`:2908-2923`, `:3079-3083`).
- FLS refuses an aggregate over an unreadable field. Step 2.5b collects every `groupBy` and `aggregations[].field` and throws `PermissionDeniedError` when one is unreadable or masked for the caller (`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts:1899-1947`); the error is 403 (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/errors.ts:43-44`). The lane field is covered too, as a group key. The board asks nothing when its own `checkField` says unreadable and draws no figure on a rejected read (`ObjectKanban.tsx:1647`, the effect's rejection arm). `security_findings: none` stands.
- The changed hunks teach permission behaviour (the spec describe now says a field the reader may not read shows no figure). The statement is true by the lines above.

**SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5):** no finding. One grouped aggregate per board; no id materialisation, no in-app join, no fetch-then-add on the path the board queries itself. The one in-app reduction is over GROUP rows, not records: off-lane and empty-key groups fold into "Uncategorized", and `avg` asks `COUNT(field)` beside it to weigh that fold (count over a field counts non-null values per the spec's aggregation conformance). The reason is given in the module docblock, and the engine's `groupBy` takes field names only, so the fold cannot be pushed down today. Accepted.

**The dev's other out-of-scope notes:**
- Picker (class a): answered by (2) / S2.
- Dead `loadedOnly` locale key: in S2.
- "ListView boards that do not page lanes hand a page of rows to the board" (noted, not filed): not acceptable as unfiled; see S4.

**Further notes for the seat:**
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no relay-bypass note is owed.
- The PR is still a draft, and auto-merge is not armed, so nothing needs disarming.
- The `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line names #36422; that card now owes the three new arms as well, as the line says.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` against card #36520 and its first consumer (`ObjectKanban` / `KanbanImpl`):

- Where the board queries its own cards (paged lanes, and a board of one query), the text is true. The figure comes from the grouped aggregate over the same filter and search, lane keys match the way each path buckets its cards (exact on paged lanes as `laneQueryFilter` / `uncolumnedQueryFilter` do; case-folded on a one-query board), a changed question shows no figure until its own answer lands, and a pending, refused or unanswerable read draws nothing. The 70-record pin, the per-function pins, the refusal and no-door pins and the ablation (7 of 17 red) cover it.
- `min` / `max` describes say "the field", not "the number field": right, the table admits temporal types for those two rows and the fold compares ISO strings.

- **S3 (should-fix)** — a cut answer is read as a whole one, and an absent group as an empty lane. The read names no `limit`. On a deployment that sets `OS_DATA_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` or `OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE`, the grouped branch is a `list` read, takes the default page size as its limit and slices the group rows, answering `hasMore: true` (`protocol-data-crud.ts:644-645`, `:671-678`; `packages/types/src/query-read-limits.ts:255`). `queryGroupHeaders` returns `records` alone (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:7700-7715`), and `laneFigureOf` gives `0` to a `sum` lane no group answered for (`KanbanLaneStatistic.ts:236-243`). So when the filtered set holds more distinct lane values than that page (lanes drawn from the data over a lookup, or fixed lanes over a field with many off-lane values), a lane with records can draw "Sum 0" and "Uncategorized" an understated total, with no marker. That contradicts this head's own rule (no figure in place of a partial one) and the describe ("over all of its records"). Read, not run. Within the diff: a lane the board knows holds records (its server count on a paged lane, its cards otherwise) and no group answered for draws no figure. The whole answer needs the door to hand back `hasMore`, which is `data-objectstack`, outside this surface: a follow-up card, with the read drawing no figure at all on a cut answer once it can see one.
- **S4 (should-fix)** — the published text is not true on one shipped path, and Done-when line 3 asks that it be. Under `ListView`, a board whose lanes are not known before the query (a lane field without options, such as a lookup, or a view with grouping) is not lane-paged (`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:4009-4017`) and is handed ListView's fetched window as `data` (`:8689`). The board then does not query itself (`ObjectKanban.tsx:1680`), `figures` is absent, and `LaneFootStatistic` adds the handed cards for a `sum` (`KanbanImpl.tsx:814`). That is a sum over one page with no marker, while the docblock now says the aggregates are "never added up over the cards a lane has loaded" and the changeset says such cards are handed in "whole". The drawing itself predates this head (no label on that path at the merge-base either); what this head changes is the contract sentence. Make the three texts (docblock, `KanbanConfig.summary` describe, changeset) state the carve-out as it is, and file the follow-up card for the ListView path instead of leaving it noted and unfiled. `avg` / `min` / `max` draw nothing there, which is right.

Nits, no effect on correctness or the contract:
- N1: the lint hint "Aggregate a number field of …" is also printed for `min` / `max`, which accept date, datetime and time fields.
- N2: a `sum` over a record-mode currency field now draws nothing (PR body) and `kanbanSummaryRefusal` has no row for it, so the author gets no finding and the picker still offers the field. Follow-up card.
- N3: folding several group sums in JS (`total += value`) drops the scale handling `sumLaneField` has; the cell renderer rounds on display.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e3e1e77a9fef258c414ca23c7d6791565b0655f2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanLaneStatistic.ts, ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (11 packs), content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx, .changeset/36520-kanban-lane-statistic-server.md

Delta round on my own round-1 record 7123350562 (head `fcd041c766`, S1 to S4). Read: the delta `fcd041c7..e3e1e77a` (19 files, three commits, main not merged), the PR body and changeset at this head, the dev's delta report 7124170115 and the claim amendment on card #36520, and the 74 check-runs on this head (63 success, 11 skipped, none red). Nothing built or run. Everything round 1 judged outside the delta stands as written there.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **S1: closed.** `Metadata-protocol: semantic` in the PR body and in the changeset, with the plain sentence on what a stored `sum` now draws.
- **S2: closed.** `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` names `avg` / `min` / `max` and offers each over the fields it offers for `sum`; the three labels are in all 11 packs and `kanban.laneStatistic.loadedOnly` is gone from every one (no reference left under `ui/`).
- **S3: closed.** `laneFigureOf` takes `holdsRecords` and draws no figure for a lane with a count above zero and no group; pinned (Won with 5 records and no group draws nothing, empty Lost draws 0), ablation red on that pin. The remainder is the accepted deviation under ③ (a).
- **S4: closed.** The schema docblock, the `KanbanConfig.summary` describe, the `LaneFootStatistic` comment and the changeset state the host-handed carve-out as it is; "whole" is gone.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set**: unchanged in the delta. The spec hunks are prose only (docblock, one describe); no arm, key or refusal moves.
- **`ViewSettingsKanban.summary` picker** now writes `{ type: 'avg' | 'min' | 'max', field }`: right. Every pair it can write is one the lint row accepts: the offered fields are the `sum` row less the boolean class (`ListView.tsx` `boardNumberFields` through `laneStatisticSums`), and the `sum` row is inside the `avg`, `min` and `max` rows (`packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts:215-220`).
- **`laneFigureOf` gains a required fourth parameter**: package-private (round 1), its one caller passes it.
- **Locale packs**: three keys added under `list.optionsMenu`, one removed; the key-parity suite is in the green CI run.

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: semantic` and `Clause-②: yes`: right, for the reasons in round 1 ③ (1).
- `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` minor: unchanged and right.
- `@object-ui/i18n` minor, new in the delta: right, the packs are moved by a changeset whose kind is not `none`.
- No `(narrowing)` arm and no BREAKING carrier owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

**(a) No explicit `limit` on the lane read: accepted, option A.** Round 1 did not ask for one, and the dev's reasoning holds against the door: the grouped answer has one row per distinct lane value of the filtered set, so a limit equal to the lane count cuts sooner than the default page whenever off-lane values exist, and a limit over the maximum page size is refused before the driver (`packages/types/src/query-read-limits.ts`, the `request.limit !== undefined` arm).

Does the guard close the wrong-figure risk in full? No, and the record says where it stops:
- Closed: a lane that matches one group exactly (every paged lane, whose count is the server's) can no longer draw "Sum 0" over records. `avg` / `min` / `max` never had that case: a lane with no group already drew nothing.
- Open under a cut answer, until the door hands back `hasMore`: (i) a lane that FOLDS several groups ("Uncategorized", and a case-folded lane on a board of one query) has a group to read, so a dropped sibling group leaves an understated `sum`, and an `avg`, `min` or `max` over part of the lane, with no marker; (ii) on a board of one query the count passed is the loaded cards (`KanbanImpl.tsx:1164`), so a lane whose records all lie past the row cap reads as empty and can still draw "Sum 0" when its group was cut.
- Both need the same precondition as round 1 S3 (a deployment read limit, and more distinct lane values in the filtered set than its default page) and the same remedy, so they are an accepted deviation carried by the `hasMore` follow-up, not a finding on this head. Condition on the seat: that card names (i) and (ii), and says the board draws no `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` figure at all on an answer it can see was cut.

**(b) Picker offers number fields only for `min` / `max`: acceptable split.** The picker offers a subset of what the lint row admits, never a pair the rule refuses, so the two authoring surfaces do not contradict each other. What remains is cosmetic: a view authored by hand with `min` over a date field shows its name in the settings row and no option selected, and choosing nothing leaves it as stored. A follow-up card, as the dev recommends; `percent` for `avg` belongs on the same card (the `sum` row leaves it out, the `avg` row admits it).

**Dev open questions**: both answered above (A, and B as a follow-up). `security_findings: none` stands; no changed hunk in the delta touches a permission path, and the round-1 verification of the read scope, RLS and FLS lines is unaffected.

**SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5)**: no finding. The delta adds no read; the guard reads a count the board already holds.

**For the seat before landing**: the changeset and the PR body say the two follow-ups are "filed by the seat" (the `hasMore` door, the ListView one-page `sum`). I did not see either card; the sentence ships in `CHANGELOG.md`, so file them first. The PR is still a draft and auto-merge is not armed. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, no relay-bypass note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, each new sentence against the code at this head:

- Docblock carve-out, "a board that does not query its own cards adds up a `sum` over the cards its host hands it (the other three draw nothing there)": true (`KanbanImpl.tsx`, the `figures === undefined` arm).
- "The list view hands a board whose lanes it cannot know before the query — lanes over a lookup field, or a view with grouping — the page of records it fetched": true (`ListView.tsx` `kanbanLanesPaged` needs the lane field's options and no grouping; otherwise `data` is passed).
- The describe's "Known gap" sentence says the same in one line and is true on the same lines. Publishing a known gap in a describe is unusual but it is what makes Done-when line 3 hold; the follow-up that closes the gap removes the sentence.
- `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`: the three regenerated rows carry the new describe; `check:generated` is green on this head.

Implementing files:
- `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`: the new paragraph on `laneFigureOf` is true to `protocol-data-crud.ts:644-645`, `:671-678` and to `queryGroupHeaders` returning `records` alone. Its scope is the one-group lane, as ③ (a) records.
- Changeset: "shows no figure rather than `0`" is true where the board holds a count above zero for the lane; the picker sentence and the locale sentence are true.

Nits, no effect on the contract:
- N1 (round 1, open): the lint hint "Aggregate a number field of …" is also printed for `min` / `max`, which take date fields.
- N2 (round 1, open): a `sum` over a record-mode currency field draws nothing and gets no lint finding; follow-up card.
- N3: the settings row says "Average" (`list.optionsMenu.kanbanSummaryAvg`) where the lane foot says "Avg" (`grid.summary.avg`); two words for one calculation.
